wan_to_lan.description: WAN-side PC runs iperf3 client to Router WAN IP. Router DNAT forwards TCP/5201 to LAN-side iperf3 server.

lan_to_wan.description: WAN-side PC runs iperf3 client with reverse mode. LAN-side iperf3 server sends traffic back to WAN-side PC.

manual_prerequisite: Start iperf3 server on LAN-side PC: iperf3 -s
Configure RouterOS dst-nat TCP/5201 from WAN interface to LAN server IP
Configure RouterOS firewall forward allow TCP/5201 to LAN server IP
Confirm router WAN IP before running iperf3
